name: Gille Dubh

attributes.attribute: is a fairy man of the Scottish Highlands
rescued the lost and cared for the needy
vanished after lairds hunted him for sport

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gille Dubh is a Scottish fairy man. He appeared near Loch a Druing in the Highlands at the end of the eighteenth century. He wore only moss and leaves, and his black unkempt hair hung about him like a cloak. A silent and kindly figure, he rescued the lost and cared for the needy. Local lairds turned him into sport and used him for target practice. He vanished and was never seen again.

okr.objective: Document the Scottish fairy Gille Dubh and his disappearance.
